title: Variance Report
description: ANALYZE-stage artifact. Output of variance-analyzer. Checks that the number of seeds meets the threshold declared in the domain profile (or a conservative default) before treating variance estimates as reliable. seed_count_insufficient is derived mechanically by variance_audit.py.

condition_id.description: The condition_id this variance report covers (null means across-all)

n_seeds.description: Number of distinct seed runs observed for this condition

min_seeds_required.description: Threshold from domain profile or built-in default; null = default applied

seed_count_insufficient.description: True iff n_seeds < min_seeds_required — derived, never hand-set

per_metric_variance.description: Per-metric mean and std across seeds; empty if no metric data available

stability_label.description: Human-readable stability assessment; derived from seed count and variance magnitude
